experiment_data.hypothesis: Perplexity tail features (p90_ppl, kurtosis_ppl, var_ppl, etc.) remain the top-ranked feature family under permutation importance (not Gini), with stable bootstrap rank CIs across all 9 model-strategy cells, refuting R17's concern that VIF>10 collinearity invalidates importance rankings.

spec.data_path: data/ + results/ (9 cell feature JSONL files, 20k samples each)

metrics.note: Top-2 individual features stable across all 9 cells (bootstrap CI width < 0.5). Family-level: surprisal > perplexity due to var_surprisal dominance. Core R17 refutation: importance rankings robust under conditional PI despite VIF>10.
